source_policy: Primary papers, author code and official runtime docs; third-party Cascade implementation explicitly labeled. Search absence is qualified, not proof. External speedups are not predictions for GLM-5.3 on Spark.

local_causality_notes: DFlash2 selector writes existing FP32 max_requests x7 xselector_top_k realized path scores. Candidate-set normalization is not calibrated target agreement.
V2 ModelRunner starts AsyncOutput copy before speculator.propose; same-block selector features cannot simply piggyback that copy.
Current policy forces K7 for first8 observations regardless of prior and policy off constructs no controller.

proposed_request_hint.scope: One provider request; cannot modify an already running stream. Server owns eligibility and calibrated prior mapping; no client-fixed cap.
